name: Wemos D1 Mini (ESP8266)
fullName: Wemos D1 Mini ESP8266 Wi-Fi Development Board
description: The Wemos D1 Mini is a compact, breadboard-friendly IoT board based on the ESP8266EX chip. It features 11 digital I/O pins, 1 analog input (0–3.2V), integrated 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi, 4MB Flash memory, and a micro-USB/Type-C interface with CH340 / CP2104 USB-to-UART chip.

specs.wireless: 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi (STA, AP, STA+AP modes, WPA/WPA2)
specs.digitalPins: 11 (all support PWM, Interrupts, I2C, and One-Wire except D0)

wiringNote: D1 is SCL and D2 is SDA. Always keep logic levels at 3.3V.
libraryName: ESP8266 Board Core for Arduino IDE
commonMistakes: Applying 5V directly to GPIO pins (board is 3.3V logic)
Connecting analog signals higher than 3.2V to A0 pin
